svg.title: FASTT: feature-adaptive speech-to-text model selection
svg.desc: Three frozen expert encoders provide feature vectors, concatenated with other features into 1k+ features whose useful dimensions are unknown beforehand. A right-pointing brace feeds FASTT. The FASTT Framework jointly learns a feature transform and selector using either FASTT-Boosted for differentiable meta learners (per-round learned transforms and, for example, soft trees; summed logits) or FASTT-Alternating for non-differentiable meta learners (for example, XGBoost refits alternating with transform updates through a linear surrogate). Both support gating, linear, low-rank and nonlinear transforms. Soft gates distribute routing mass, whereas hard splits choose a path. Both yield expert weights; argmax selects one decoder. Offline expected WER is the sum of expert probabilities times their WER. Feature shades, tree routing, expert weights and the selected expert are schematic.
